column1: Modelled price at year-ahead vs day-ahead wholesale
Real 2025 USD/MWh unless stated (annual-average market FX, Fed H.10; deflated with US CPI-U). Excludes VAT.

Modelled prices with full exemptions, supplier costs included. Year-ahead = wholesale at the forward price traded the year before delivery; day-ahead = delivery-year spot. UK prices at day-ahead before 2022, so its two lines coincide. Purple (UK, from 2018): wholesale averaged over the last three vintages, price weighted 85% unrelieved / 15% relieved (2024–25 exempt share). Shaded corridor (DE large) = partially relieved firm. Observed = survey band average, including unrelieved firms. Sources. EEX Phelix front-year; day-ahead annual averages from energy-charts/SMARD and the UK day-ahead series.
